candidates.raw_title: MS-Hu6 (anti-FSH antibody) ultra-high concentration formulation, eLife 2023
candidates.reject_reason: Gate E: WebFetch of the primary paper (PMC10325703) shows the achieved concentration is only 100 mg/mL via a conventional excipient liquid formulation (phosphate buffer, sucrose, Tween 20, L-methionine, EDTA) -- below the tracker's own existing benchmark (Dupixent, 150 mg/mL) and with no named enabling delivery technology. Despite the paper's title using 'ultra-high concentration,' it does not advance the tracker's concentration/volume question and would mislead a reader if logged as a finding. Also 2023, well-aged, no commercial platform tie beyond an institutional (Mount Sinai) patent filing.

findings.event: TAK-881 (20% SCIG, rHuPH20) pivotal Phase 2/3 topline vs. HYQVIA (10% Ig)
findings.summary: Takeda's TAK-881 (20% facilitated SCIG + Halozyme's rHuPH20) met its primary PK endpoint vs. the company's own marketed HYQVIA (10% Ig + rHuPH20) in a pivotal Phase 2/3 PID trial; Takeda states it delivers the same dose in half the volume.
findings.summary_ko: Takeda의 TAK-881(20% 촉진 SCIG + 할로자임 rHuPH20)이 자사 시판 제품 HYQVIA(10% 면역글로불린 + rHuPH20) 대비 핵심 2/3상 PID 시험에서 1차 약동학 평가변수를 충족했다. Takeda는 동일 용량을 HYQVIA의 절반 부피로 투여할 수 있다고 밝혔다.

findings.event: VYVGART/VYVGART Hytrulo FDA label expansion to all gMG antibody serotypes
findings.summary: FDA approved an sBLA expanding VYVGART/VYVGART Hytrulo (ENHANZE/rHuPH20-enabled) to all adult gMG patients regardless of antibody serotype, based on the Phase 3 ADAPT SERON trial.
findings.summary_ko: FDA가 보충 생물학적제제 허가신청(sBLA)을 승인해 VYVGART/VYVGART Hytrulo(ENHANZE-rHuPH20 기반)의 적응증을 항체 혈청형과 무관하게 모든 성인 gMG 환자로 확대했으며, 3상 ADAPT SERON 시험에 근거했다.

findings.event: Health Canada approval of KEYTRUDA SC
findings.summary: Health Canada approved KEYTRUDA SC (ALT-B4-enabled pembrolizumab), completing the Canada gap in the tracker's already-itemized per-country Keytruda SC installed base.
findings.summary_ko: 캐나다 보건부가 KEYTRUDA SC(ALT-B4 기반 펨브롤리주맙)를 승인하여, 이미 국가별로 항목화된 키트루다 SC 설치 기반에서 캐나다 공백을 채웠다.
